column7: Read John 14:26 and 27, and Colossians 3:14 and 15. His voice never disturbs us. It is a voice that brings perfect peace. Inner peace is because there is a KNOWING which brings us confidence before God, which translates into perfect peace. If the voice you are listening to disturbs you, you are not hearing from God-shut it off. Jesus promised us peace, not as the world gives but as He gives us through the Holy Spirit’s comforting words and constant abiding (John 14:27).

column7: God never takes you down! He will never run you down; He only builds you up. When God speaks to you, He is speaking from the frame of reference that everything the Word says about you has already been accomplished and ACCEPTED by you. Jeremiah 33:3 says: “Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you **GREAT AND MIGHTY** things which you do not know.” Does that sound like running you down or doom and gloom? There is NO doom and gloom in God, therefore He cannot tell you anything doomy or gloomy. You’ll have to tune in to the world’s news agency for doom and gloom.
